High above, circling the skies with long outstretched webbed wings catching thermals, the enormous bat's golden eyes glint as it tracks 
smaller terrestrial predators stalking their own prey far below. Watching hungrily as the vinnirex pack charges in tandem, executing 
their kill masterfully. Th e canines joyfully tear into their meal, but for a moment until a shadow soon casts over them. With wings 
pulled back, the skyelarx plummets, howling wildly. Within a heartbeat before hitting the earth, its wings snap out and lethally sharp 
talons plunge into the freshly killed carcass, claiming it as its own. Staring at the pack of vinnirex with its sinister golden eyes, it leaps 
upward, beating its wings and rises back into the air before the stunned canines can take back their prize.

Multiattack Th e skyelarx makes two attacks, it can use its Clawed 
Feet, Taloned Wings or Howling Screech in any combination.
Clawed Feet Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.
Taloned Wings Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the skyelarx flies at least 30 
ft. toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes 
an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage.
Howling Screech (Recharge 3–6) Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 16, 
each creature in a 30 ft. Cone. Failure: Target creature has the

Agile Flier While the skyelarx is flying, it gains a +2 bonus to its 
AC (total 15) against ranged attacks made by creatures it can see. 
Additionally, when it takes the Dash Action, it can use a Bonus 
Action to make a single attack with its Talon-Tipped Wings 
against a creature it passes within 5 ft. of.
